full_name: Aisha Khan | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Social Sciences Maury Green Fellow New York University
bio: Aisha Khan is a member of the Department of Anthropology at New York University. She is also affiliated with NYU’s Center for Latin American and Caribbean Studies and Hagop Kevorkian Center for Near Eastern Studies. Her research interests focus on religion, race, and Atlantic world diasporas (particularly Asian and African).
